title: Why I Built Sentire to Track My Hearing History
description: Living with lifelong hearing loss and years of fluctuating hearing led me to create Sentire: a private desktop home for audiograms and hearing history.
excerpt: A lifetime of hearing loss, a decade of fluctuations, and a simple need: a clearer record of my own hearing. This is the story behind Sentire.
author: jw
imageAlt: Sentire’s desktop overview showing a hearing-history timeline and charts with fictional example records.
imageCaption: The overview in Sentire. All records shown in this product screenshot are fictional.
